introduction: At this level, we cover the absolute most frequently asked research institutes. These are primarily related to India's core agricultural, dairy, and forestry sectors. The headquarters of these institutes are non-negotiable for any aspirant.

core_concepts.title: National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Karnal, Haryana**. 
Key Fact: It is India's premier institute for dairy research. It gained global fame for cloning the first buffalo calf (named 'Samrupa').

core_concepts.title: National Rice Research Institute (NRRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Cuttack, Odisha**. 
Key Fact: Situated on the banks of the Mahanadi river, it plays a critical role in developing high-yielding rice varieties.

core_concepts.title: Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Shimla, Himachal Pradesh**. 
Key Fact: Located in the hills because potatoes require cool climates for disease-free seed production.

core_concepts.title: Forest Research Institute (FRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Dehradun, Uttarakhand**. 
Key Fact: It is one of the oldest institutions of its kind. The majestic FRI building is famous and often featured in Bollywood movies.

important_entities.name: Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI)
important_entities.significance: Commonly known as the **Pusa Institute**, it was the leading institute behind India's 'Green Revolution' in the 1970s.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: West Bengal is the largest producer of rice in India. Because of this, students often guess a city in West Bengal for the Rice Research Institute. Remember, the institute is in **Cuttack (Odisha)**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: To remember the Central Potato Research Institute, just remember that potatoes love cold weather, hence it is located in the snowy hills of **Shimla**.

exam_strategy_tips: A guaranteed SSC CHSL/MTS question: 'Where is the National Rice Research Institute located?' Answer: Cuttack.
